title: Indian Vegetable Rasam
description: A flavorful and comforting South Indian rasam recipe made with fresh vegetables and spices. This dish is perfect for a chilly evening or as a side for your favorite Indian meals.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until it turns translucent.
Add the chopped tomato and sauté for another 2 minutes.
Add the chopped carrot and potato and sauté for 3-4 minutes.
Add the rasam powder and mix well.
Add the coconut milk and mix well.
Add the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Serve hot with rice or roti.
